steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure clauses are not automatically mandatory.
Enable the single-stage RFQ creation flow.
Allow adding the QA vendor during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ and award the entire lot.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Set the requested delivery location.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions on the single-stage RFQ, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the event-wise terms with the required and optional modes requested by the case.
Invite the available QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal in a separate session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round.
Verify the required clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the vendor bid was submitted successfully, demonstrating that the portal accepted the clause selections.
